conf.description: IBM Guardium DAM audit-report-exports, api-pull (CSV): parses the header-labeled CSV export via serde csv, maps every column with eval bracket-access because Guardium's CSV headers are human-readable strings with embedded spaces (rename cannot target them), converts Severity Description to numeric event.severity, and sets _time from the report's own Timestamp column rather than collection/ingest time since a batch export can backfill hours-old rows.

conf.comment: Audit process CSV export (Policy Violations / Incident Management report spine). Header row present; column set is per-report and site-tunable, so every source name below is read positionally by header label, not by column index.

functions.description: Parse the CSV row into fields named for their header column

Map every column via bracket access on its space-containing CSV header name (rename.currentName cannot accept a name with spaces); TCP passes through to network.transport, local-IPC values (Named Pipes, Shared Memory, Bequeath, IPC) route to a custom field instead

functions.description: Best-effort parse the local-timezone Timestamp column into _time (the appliance's real UTC offset is unknown, so this assumes the rendered value is UTC — documented gap); delete the original space-named CSV columns now that eval has copied their values, since rename/eval.remove cannot target a name containing a space
